leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply TypeScript interfaces to define the structure of dashboard data objects
Implement React hooks to manage real-time data state within functional components
Use conditional rendering to display loading states while data is being fetched
Construct responsive grid layouts using CSS Grid to organize dashboard widgets
Execute API calls with fetch or axios to retrieve live data from a backend service
Handle user interactions by implementing click handlers for dashboard controls
Utilize useEffect hooks to set up intervals for periodic data updates
Define reusable component functions to render individual data visualization widgets
Apply TypeScript generics to create flexible data-fetching utilities
Control component re-renders by properly managing dependencies in useEffect
Modify component state to reflect real-time data changes and trigger UI updates
Return structured JSX with proper TypeScript typing for all component props
